## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass

- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] No new permissions, plugins or dependencies — or they are justified below
- [ ] Nothing runs commands automatically, elevates privileges, or exposes paths/command lines unnecessarily
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under "Unreleased" (user-facing changes)
